project.title: Development of a Data Warehouse and Application of Data Mining Techniques for Customer Churn Analysis in the Telecommunications Sector

dimensions.name: dim_service
ddl_columns: UNIQUE KEY uq_service (phone_service, multiple_lines, internet_service, online_security, online_backup, device_protection, tech_support, streaming_tv, streaming_movies)

queries.description: Fact rows with an invalid dimension link (expect 0)
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_links FROM fact_customer_churn f LEFT JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_key=c.customer_key LEFT JOIN dim_contract k ON f.contract_key=k.contract_key LEFT JOIN dim_service s ON f.service_key=s.service_key LEFT JOIN dim_payment p ON f.payment_key=p.payment_key LEFT JOIN dim_churn ch ON f.churn_key=ch.churn_key WHERE c.customer_key IS NULL OR k.contract_key IS NULL OR s.service_key IS NULL OR p.payment_key IS NULL OR ch.churn_key IS NULL

queries.description: Distinct customer keys in the fact table (expect 7043)
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) AS unique_customer_keys FROM fact_customer_churn

SELECT ch.churn_label, COUNT(*) AS customers, ROUND(100*COUNT(*)/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_customer_churn),2) AS pct FROM fact_customer_churn f JOIN dim_churn ch ON f.churn_key=ch.churn_key GROUP BY ch.churn_label ORDER BY ch.churn_label

analysis_queries.description: Churn rate by contract type (expect Month-to-month 1655/3875=42.71%, One year 166/1473=11.27%, Two year 48/1695=2.83%)
analysis_queries.sql: SELECT k.contract_type, COUNT(*) AS customers, SUM(ch.churn_flag) AS churned, ROUND(100*SUM(ch.churn_flag)/COUNT(*),2) AS churn_rate_pct FROM fact_customer_churn f JOIN dim_contract k ON f.contract_key=k.contract_key JOIN dim_churn ch ON f.churn_key=ch.churn_key GROUP BY k.contract_type ORDER BY churn_rate_pct DESC

analysis_queries.description: Churn rate by tenure band (expect 0-12 months: 1037/2186=47.44%)
analysis_queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN f.tenure<=12 THEN '0-12' WHEN f.tenure<=24 THEN '13-24' WHEN f.tenure<=48 THEN '25-48' ELSE '49-72' END AS tenure_band, COUNT(*) AS customers, SUM(ch.churn_flag) AS churned, ROUND(100*SUM(ch.churn_flag)/COUNT(*),2) AS churn_rate_pct FROM fact_customer_churn f JOIN dim_churn ch ON f.churn_key=ch.churn_key GROUP BY tenure_band ORDER BY MIN(f.tenure)

analysis_queries.description: Churn rate by payment method (expect Electronic check 1071/2365=45.29%)
analysis_queries.sql: SELECT p.payment_method, COUNT(*) AS customers, SUM(ch.churn_flag) AS churned, ROUND(100*SUM(ch.churn_flag)/COUNT(*),2) AS churn_rate_pct FROM fact_customer_churn f JOIN dim_payment p ON f.payment_key=p.payment_key JOIN dim_churn ch ON f.churn_key=ch.churn_key GROUP BY p.payment_method ORDER BY churn_rate_pct DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers, SUM(ch.churn_flag) AS churned, ROUND(100*SUM(ch.churn_flag)/COUNT(*),2) AS churn_rate_pct FROM fact_customer_churn f JOIN dim_contract k ON f.contract_key=k.contract_key JOIN dim_payment p ON f.payment_key=p.payment_key JOIN dim_churn ch ON f.churn_key=ch.churn_key WHERE k.contract_type='Month-to-month' AND p.payment_method='Electronic check'

analysis_queries.description: Churn rate by internet service type
analysis_queries.sql: SELECT s.internet_service, COUNT(*) AS customers, SUM(ch.churn_flag) AS churned, ROUND(100*SUM(ch.churn_flag)/COUNT(*),2) AS churn_rate_pct FROM fact_customer_churn f JOIN dim_service s ON f.service_key=s.service_key JOIN dim_churn ch ON f.churn_key=ch.churn_key GROUP BY s.internet_service ORDER BY churn_rate_pct DESC

analysis_queries.description: Average monthly charges and tenure by churn label
analysis_queries.sql: SELECT ch.churn_label, ROUND(AVG(f.monthly_charges),2) AS avg_monthly_charges, ROUND(AVG(f.tenure),1) AS avg_tenure FROM fact_customer_churn f JOIN dim_churn ch ON f.churn_key=ch.churn_key GROUP BY ch.churn_label
